blob: sewage gravity flows to the existing raw sewage collection sump from where it is pumped to the treatment plant two submersible pumps will be provided at the existing sewage collection sump suitably sized to transfer settled sewage to the proposed treatment plant for the required duty, grinder pumps will be selected biological treatment of wastewater takes place in three modified 6m shipping containers removal of inert solids treatment processes include removal or organic material and dissolved nitrogen compounds disinfection flow and energy measurement re-use of treated water includes irrigation and flushing toilets safe discharge to the environment dust suppression and fire control water quality is compliant with the DWS General Limit
lines: • sewage gravity flows to the existing raw sewage collection sump from where it is pumped to the treatment plant
• two submersible pumps will be provided at the existing sewage collection sump suitably sized to transfer settled sewage to
the proposed treatment plant for the required duty, grinder pumps will be selected
• biological treatment of wastewater takes place in three modified 6m shipping containers
• treatment processes include removal or organic material and dissolved nitrogen compounds
• re-use of treated water includes irrigation and flushing toilets
• water quality is compliant with the DWS General Limit
